buttonizationNotes:
decorateButtons lives in scripts/scripts.js (not aem.js): requires / around the , a alone in its

, skips a[href] whose text equals its URL and anchors containing ; replaces the emphasis tag with the classed anchor; sets a.title from textContent
fragmentLoader: blocks/fragment/fragment.js loadFragment(path) fetches <path>.plain.html into a detached <main> via innerHTML (scripts inert), rewrites ./media_ src/srcset, then runs decorateMain + loadSections on it; header/footer blocks call it for /nav and /footer (overridable via nav/footer metadata)
emptySectionNotes: decorateSections never removes an empty section and the boilerplate styles.css carries no :empty rule; the pipeline drops sections that end up empty. Foundation adds main .section:empty { display: none } as the documented fallback anyway
sectionStatus: decorateSections sets data-section-status=initialized + inline display:none; loadSections flips to loaded
bodyGate: body { display: none } / body.appear — loadEager adds appear after decorateMain
chromeReservation: header { height: var(--nav-height) } + header .header / footer .footer { visibility: hidden } until [data-block-status=loaded]
fonts: loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css eagerly when innerWidth >= 900 or sessionStorage fonts-loaded, always in loadLazy; lazy-styles.css also loaded in loadLazy
trustedTypes: scripts.js installs a default Trusted Types policy (createHTML strips <script> for createContextualFragment/document.write sinks); head.html CSP require-trusted-types-for 'script' — innerHTML assignments in block JS are allowed as HTML strings
isDesktopBreakpoint: blocks/header/header.js isDesktop = matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)'); lifted chrome breakpoint is 768 (canon.css) — header block overrides isDesktop to (min-width: 768px) so the hamburger switch matches the replica
stockHeaderQuirk: stock header.js reads brandLink.closest('.button-container') — this clone emits p.button-wrapper; fixed in the project header block
